review_method: Direct visual inspection of each final required PNG and actual Chromium production-page screenshot.
observations: Clean compact-car proportions; coherent neutral walls, graphite floor and polished trim.
Four telescopic leaves are stowed at the sides; aperture remains clear.
Eight unlabelled buttons are visible in the three-quarter view.
Mirror, rear/side handrail, ceiling panel and threshold tracks are present.
Removed overlapping coplanar header/post and floor/sill faces seen during initial review.
Side view intentionally shows a closed, plain exterior wall.
Chromium default frame contains the entire model and matches the measured GLB hash.
Additional close interior view confirms mirror frame, ceiling diffuser and rail supports; full control panel remains visible in the three-quarter view.
limitations: Mirror reflects the PBR studio environment in the browser; no live planar reflection or simulated passenger transport. Runtime framing uses the existing gallery.
